hero.eyebrow: Truck and trailer repair · Roadside assistance
hero.title: Truck & trailer repair that keeps you moving.
hero.lead: Roadside help, repairs, DOT inspections and maintenance for owner-operators and fleets, from our shop in {{city}}.

why.title: Why drivers choose Sunny Side
why.intro: You don't have time to be confused by your own truck. Here's how we work.

items.title: Straight answers
items.text: We explain what's wrong, what it will cost and what can wait, before any work starts.

items.title: Respect for your time
items.text: Downtime costs money. We keep you posted and work to get you back on the road.

items.title: Built for heavy-duty
items.text: Tractors, straight trucks and trailers are what we work on every day.

items.title: There when it counts
items.text: Roadside help for the moments that can't wait for a shop appointment.

process.title: How it works
process.intro: From the first call to back on the road.

steps.title: Call or request service
steps.text: Tell us what's going on. If you're on the road, we'll ask where you are.

steps.title: We diagnose and quote
steps.text: You get a clear estimate and we wait for your go-ahead.

steps.title: We fix it right
steps.text: Skilled technicians do the work, and we test the result.

steps.title: Back on the road
steps.text: You get a rundown of what we did, and a record for next time.

roadside.title: Stuck on the road? We come to you.
roadside.text: Flat tire, dead battery, air leak, lights out. Call, tell us where you are, and we'll send help.

fleet.title: Running more than one truck?
fleet.text: We keep fleets moving with preventive maintenance programs, inspection tracking and a single number to call.
bullets: Maintenance schedules built around your trucks

hero.title: Broken down? Call us.
hero.lead: Tell us where you are and what's happening. We'll get help rolling.

now.title: What to do right now
now.intro: Stay calm and work through this list. It takes a few minutes and it keeps you safer.

steps.title: Get safe
steps.text: Turn on your hazard flashers right away and move as far from traffic as you safely can. If you can't get off the road, stay buckled up in the cab and call 911.

steps.title: Set out warning devices
steps.text: Federal rules (49 CFR 392.22) call for warning devices such as reflective triangles within 10 minutes of stopping on a road or shoulder. Only get out when it's safe.

steps.title: Call us
steps.text: Phone {{phone}}. Tell us where you are, what happened and whether you're loaded.

steps.title: Know your location
steps.text: Mile marker, exit number, direction of travel or the nearest cross street. Or use the share-location button on this page.

steps.title: Describe what you see
steps.text: Warning lights, noises, smells, leaks, and what the truck was doing when it happened.

steps.title: Stay safe while you wait
steps.text: Stay clear of traffic, wear a high-visibility vest if you have one, and wait behind a guardrail if you can do so safely.

ready.title: Have this ready when you call
items: Your name and a number we can reach
Your location: mile marker, exit or cross street
Truck and trailer type, and unit number
What's wrong, and anything you've noticed
Whether you're loaded, and any deadline
Company or account name, if you're with a fleet

items.title: Flats and blowouts
items.text: Tire changes and repairs on the spot.

items.title: Dead batteries
items.text: Jump-starts, testing and battery replacement.

items.title: Fuel delivery
items.text: If you've run dry, we'll bring fuel to you.

items.title: Air system problems
items.text: Hose, fitting and leak repairs that get you rolling safely.

items.title: Lights and electrical
items.text: Trailer plug, wiring and lighting fixes.

items.title: Tow coordination
items.text: If it can't be fixed roadside, we help arrange a tow to the shop.

hero.title: A shop built around the driver.
hero.lead: We're a truck and trailer repair shop in {{city}}, built around one idea: drivers deserve straight answers and careful, fast work.

story.title: Here to make a difference
paragraphs: Sunny Side exists for the moments when a truck or trailer stops earning. We pair a working shop with roadside assistance, so you can call one number whether you're sitting in our lot or stuck on the shoulder.
Our tagline says it plainly: we are here to make a difference. That means explaining the problem in plain language, giving you an honest estimate and respecting the fact that downtime costs money.

items.title: Explain it plainly
items.text: No jargon walls. You'll know what's wrong, why it matters and what your options are.

items.title: Quote it clearly
items.text: A clear estimate and your approval before work begins. No surprises on the invoice.

items.title: Fix it right
items.text: Careful work, tested before it goes back to you, because a repeat visit helps no one.

items.title: Be there when it counts
items.text: Roadside help and straight talk when you're stuck and the clock is running.

equipment.title: What we work on
items: Landing gear, doors, lights and running gear

hero.title: One shop. One number. Fewer surprises.
hero.lead: Fleet maintenance, inspections and roadside coverage from a team that learns your equipment.

items.title: Preventive maintenance programs
items.text: Service schedules built around your trucks' mileage, hours and duty cycle.

items.title: Inspection tracking
items.text: We keep track of annual inspection due dates so none sneak up on you.

items.title: Priority scheduling
items.text: Approved fleet accounts get scheduling priority when time is tight.

items.title: Itemized, transparent invoices
items.text: Clear line items and service notes that make accounting and audits easy.

items.title: Roadside coverage for your drivers
items.text: One number for every driver, whenever a truck stops.

items.title: A single point of contact
items.text: Talk to people who know your equipment and your priorities.

owners.title: Owner-operators are welcome
owners.text: You don't need a fleet to get fleet-quality service. Whether you run one truck or fifty, the same straight answers and careful work apply.
